posts.author: MetalLord4171
posts.body:
Its been a while, and as such, I come with a new asset pack.
Tilesets specifically made for Rpgmaker MV and MZ's change Tileset command.  This pack is intended to be a free sample and first entry of a larger project.
Tilesets are lined up in so that tiles of the same category (A (1-5),B, C, D, E) and type (Outside or inside).
This is intended to be a base pack for a line of additional tilesets.
Tilesets include-
Inside
Caves (With and without Lava)
Greek Temple and Roman arena
Medieval Castle
Egyptian Temple
Wood House
Modern/Scifi (2 variants- 1 shop, and 2 lab variants  with either bulletin boards or Monitors)
Outside
Biomes (with Modern and Gravel road Variants)
Normal Grass
Dark Grass
Desert
Large Buildings
Greek temple
Castle (5 Variants - 4 with different colored flags, 1 no flag) and church
Egyptian Temple
Event center/Modern Stadium and Playground
Generic buildings
Huts
Tents (two variants- tan and colored)
Wood Houses
Modern Buildings
The C category is reserved for generic tiles for almost any tileset within their themes, with past and modern variants.
LICENSE
YOU CAN:
Edit and use the asset in any commercial  or non commercial project
Use the asset in any commercial  or non commercial project
YOU CANNOT:
Resell or distribute the asset to others
Edit and resell the asset to others
Use to train any form of AI
To download the asset pack, go here:
Swappable Tilesets Starter Pack by MetalKing1417
Tilesets that are designed to be swapped with each other
metalking1417.itch.io
Spoiler:
Examples
If you have any suggestions to improve my tilesets, or ideas for new themes, please post them here.

posts.author: MetalLord4171
posts.body:
Major Update:
Added “dark” versions of various tilesets
Removed “marbled” versions of greek/roman tilesets (mostly for sanity in case of need to edit)
Split old Sci Fi C generic sets in two- modern (old version, renamed as it better suits current intent) and Sci Fi (which has a more futuristic look, with Holograms and laser bars)
“Standard” Tileset grass is now a slightly darker, less eybleeding shade
Fixed mixup with Tower walls
fixed tents in A4
A1 & A2 Beach added
Sci Fi Buildings 2 has been renamed City and has been split into multiple variants to for consistent colorations. The original color has been renamed as generic.
D Buildings have had their names shuffled around so that D Inside Generic Furniture can be found
A1 and A2 Beach added
Rearranged various Tilesets so as to minimize items being cut in half
Added stairs to go down a floor

posts.author: LunarFlareStudios
posts.body:
I love these! I'm planning to buy every single entry in this series (I already got the free base pack) and use it to create a fictional game in the universe of a series I made for YouTube. I love the idea of swapping worlds just by swapping tilesets... might even create a concept where the tileset changes when night falls.
In the universe of the series, this game is supposed to be a virus... but don't worry, I have no intention of actually infecting computers! The game idea (which will be for the video only) is inspired by Sonic Gather Battle, which I wanted to play one day until I heard it was spyware and, since then, discontinued. However, I was also highly inspired by games like Luna Game (I think it was called that) and, shockingly, KinitoPet. Why KinitoPet? Not revealing, but know that the old "Mario Virus" plays into it too...
Man, I went off on a tangent! Should I make an entire thread somewhere about the episode of "The VHS Mystery: Sideshow" where this game appears? I think I will... maybe I'd better start building the game first, though. I want something to show for this.
